'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Joe Orthner LS Careful Planning''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Joe Orthner]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Freedom'''. Username '''Gawaines'''. Handwritten. LIGHT checked. Written Yavin 4: War Room, Wedge Antilles, Leg Rogue, R2 in Red 5, Theon Nett, Qui-gon w/ Saber, Org Attack, All wings & Darklighter Spin, Professor. Shield lines 9–12 are blank.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Block 4)|Careful Planning (V)]]
* '''Username:''' Gawaines
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
